def: to break off or loose (in a favorable or unfavorable sense), i.e. desist (from grief) or invade (with destruction)

words.word: me that i may recover strength

occurrences.text: Are not my days few? cease then, and let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,
O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.
words: me that I may recover strength

occurrences.text: That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong, so that the spoiled shall come against the fortress.
